text: What is the standard integration time step for atomistic MD simulations of proteins when bonds involving hydrogen are constrained using LINCS or SHAKE?
explanation: The chapter specifies a standard time step of 2 femtoseconds when hydrogen bonds are constrained (extendable to 4 femtoseconds with hydrogen-mass repartitioning; only 1 femtosecond is stable without any constraints). Nanosecond-to-microsecond values are far too large for a single integration step -- those timescales instead describe total simulation duration, not the discrete step size.
